execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_log" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" text,
  "entity_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "new_data" json,
  "old_data" json,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."consumer_profiles" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "emergency_contact_name" text NOT NULL,
  "emergency_contact_phone" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "stripe_customer_id" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."driver_documents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "doc_type" text NOT NULL,
  "driver_id" text NOT NULL,
  "expiry_date" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "s3_key" text NOT NULL,
  "verified_at" timestamptz,
  "verified_by" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."driver_payouts" (
  "commission_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "driver_profile_id" text NOT NULL,
  "gross_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "net_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "payout_date" timestamptz,
  "period_end" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "period_start" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "stripe_transfer_id" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_payouts_status_check_244899a6" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'PAID', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."driver_profiles" (
  "acceptance_rate" numeric,
  "bank_account_ref" text,
  "base_price_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'PKR' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "licence_number" text NOT NULL,
  "operating_days" int4[] NOT NULL,
  "plate_number" text NOT NULL,
  "route_polyline" geometry(Geometry,4326),
  "seat_capacity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "stripe_account_id" text,
  "typical_departure_time" timestamptz,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "vehicle_colour" text NOT NULL,
  "vehicle_make" text NOT NULL,
  "vehicle_model" text NOT NULL,
  "vehicle_year" int4 NOT NULL,
  "verification_tier" text DEFAULT 'BASIC' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_profiles_operating_days_elem_not_null_aabaf665" CHECK (array_position("operating_days", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_profiles_status_check_c3bdbb3f" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'SUSPENDED', 'REJECTED')),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_profiles_verification_tier_check_7da11074" CHECK ("verification_tier" IN ('BASIC', 'ENHANCED', 'ELITE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."driver_schedule_slots" (
  "driver_profile_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "operating_days" int4[] NOT NULL,
  "pickup_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "slot_end" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "slot_start" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "subscription_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_schedule_slots_operating_days_elem_not_null_aabaf665" CHECK (array_position("operating_days", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."idempotency_keys" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "request_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "response" json,
  "state" text DEFAULT 'in_progress' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."location_logs" (
  "driver_profile_id" text NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "points" json DEFAULT '"[]"'::json NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "trip_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."messages" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "sender_id" text NOT NULL,
  "sent_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "subscription_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" json DEFAULT '"{}"'::json NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment_methods" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "gateway" text NOT NULL,
  "gateway_customer_id" text NOT NULL,
  "gateway_payment_method_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "is_default" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "billing_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'PKR' NOT NULL,
  "failure_reason" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" text NOT NULL,
  "receipt_url" text,
  "retry_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "stripe_payment_intent_id" text,
  "subscription_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payments_status_check_218a9bc3" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refresh_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reviews" (
  "author_id" text NOT NULL,
  "comment" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subscription_id" text NOT NULL,
  "target_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."riders" (
  "consumer_profile_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dest_address_text" text NOT NULL,
  "dest_location" geometry(Geometry,4326),
  "home_address_text" text NOT NULL,
  "home_location" geometry(Geometry,4326),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "photo_url" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscriptions" (
  "agreed_dropoff_location" geometry(Geometry,4326),
  "agreed_dropoff_time" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "agreed_pickup_location" geometry(Geometry,4326),
  "agreed_pickup_time" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "cancellation_reason" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'PKR' NOT NULL,
  "driver_profile_id" text NOT NULL,
  "dropoff_address_text" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "monthly_price_cents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "next_billing_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "pickup_address_text" text NOT NULL,
  "rider_id" text NOT NULL,
  "start_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "stripe_subscription_id" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_status_check_e7881352" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_type_check_d04a7056" CHECK ("type" IN ('MORNING', 'AFTERNOON', 'ROUND_TRIP'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."support_tickets" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resolved_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "subject" text NOT NULL,
  "trip_id" text,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."trips" (
  "actual_dropoff_at" timestamptz,
  "actual_pickup_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviation_alert_sent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "driver_profile_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location_log_id" text,
  "scheduled_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
  "subscription_id" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "trips_status_check_0612f31f" CHECK ("status" IN ('SCHEDULED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'MISSED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "trips_type_check_4f232f02" CHECK ("type" IN ('MORNING', 'AFTERNOON'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "email" text,
  "fcm_token" text,
  "full_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "preferred_language" text DEFAULT 'en' NOT NULL,
  "profile_photo_url" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'CONSUMER' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING_VERIFICATION' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_a8c41acf" CHECK ("role" IN ('CONSUMER', 'DRIVER', 'ADMIN', 'INSTITUTION_ADMIN', 'FLEET_ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_50333e84" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))
)
